entities.summary: Ilya Shinkevich is a Belarusian professional ice hockey player who is currently playing for Shakhter Soligorsk in the Kazakhstan Hockey Championship (KAZ). He has previously played in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL) with HC Dinamo Minsk and Russian entrant, HC Vityaz.
